{{Recipe summary
| Category = Meat recipes
| Difficulty = 3
}}

{{recipe}}

==Ingredients==
* 400 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]] high quality [[Cookbook:Beef|beef fillet]]
* 90 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]] extra-virgin [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|olive oil]]
* 1 small handful [[Cookbook:Pine Nut|pine kernels]], for toasting
* 50 g [[Cookbook:Parmesan Cheese|Parmesan]], for shaving
* 1 dash of [[Cookbook:Truffle|truffle]] oil, for drizzling (optional)
* [[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]]
* [[Cookbook:Black Pepper|Black pepper]]

==Procedure==
# Cut the beef fillet into extremely thin [[Cookbook:Slicing|slices]] (about 2 mm).
# Lay a piece of [[Cookbook:Plastic wrap|cling film]] on the work surface, place the sliced beef on top and place another layer of film over. Flatten the slices with the back of a knife.
# Pour a small puddle of olive oil onto a large plate and place a layer of beef over it. Season with the salt and pepper and continue making layers with all the beef.
# Cover the plate with cling film and leave to [[Cookbook:Marinating|marinate]] for half an hour.
# Meanwhile toast the pine nuts in a dry [[Cookbook:Frying Pan|frying pan]].
# Transfer the beef onto individual plates. Cover with pine nuts, shavings of Parmesan and a dash of truffle oil if you have any.
